max_rounds.description: Hard cap on unsupervised round trips.

token_cap.description: Total completion-token budget spread across provider calls.

providers.description: Default active provider set; providers without API keys are skipped at runtime.

moderator.description: Provider name used for synthesis in debate/plan.

transcript_dir.description: Directory to write JSON transcripts into (relative to repo root unless absolute).

cache.description: Exact-match disk cache for provider responses.

session_db.description: SQLite database for session state (calls/wall_ms/cache_hits/claims/claim_links). Created on first use; migrated forward via CREATE IF NOT EXISTS.

retries.description: Retry policy for transient HTTP errors (429, 5xx, network, timeout).

backoff_base_s.description: Base for jittered exponential backoff: base * 2^(attempt-1) + jitter.

rate_limits.description: Per-provider leaky-bucket rate limit; the special key `default` applies to any provider without an entry.

redaction.description: Regex-based PII/secret scrubbing applied to event traces and persisted transcripts.

patterns_extra.description: Extra regex patterns to redact (e.g. internal account ids).

provider_allowlist.description: If set, only these providers may be invoked even when the caller requests others. Null = no restriction.

events_log.description: Path to the ndjson event trace (one structured event per line).

delegation.description: Quota knobs for the `delegate` tool. Limits accepted delegations per session and per requesting provider.
